static_traits.name: Zhang Yu航
static_traits.social_status: 与同好朋友的关系因自己持续负面评论而受到影响
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；此前not yet接受心理咨询；without类似问题史
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、配合度较好、语气中性；思维易陷入负面过滤与灾难化Anticipation；尝试理性分析但容易回到消极立场

basic_info.main_problem: 在读到最喜欢的作者的新书后感到极度失望与without望，认为他以后再也写not出好书，引发持续的消极情绪与困扰，并影响阅读的愉悦感。
basic_info.core_demands: Realizes their extreme reaction to the author's new book is affecting mood and overall well-being, so seeks counseling support.

special_situations.event: 读完最喜欢的作者的新书后感到强烈失望
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果这本新书not好，就说明作者已经走下坡路，not yet来的书也会很差
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 持续关注并强调作品中的负面细节，negate以往优点以降低再次失望的可能

special_situations.event: 每当想到该作者的作品或阅读这件事
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一旦经历一次糟糕的阅读体验，此后阅读将not再带来乐趣
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 减少阅读、回避相关话题以避免负面情绪
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 阅读对我而言已经被毁了

special_situations.event: 回想自己在读书前的高期待与购买行为
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: A rational reader 'should' be able to foresee quality and avoid being deceived by 'bad works'
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 通过苛责自己与设定更严格的标准来试图防止再次失望

special_situations.event: 被提醒作者过去的优秀作品或积极面时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 最近一本书很差就说明过去的优点都not重要
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 主动忽略或贬低以往的积极体验以维持一致的负面判断
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 过去的好作品也not值得再提了

core_conflict.wish: Longing to maintain stable appreciation and a sense of meaning for beloved things (reading and authors' works)
core_conflict.fear: 害怕再次遭遇失望与落空，担心热爱之物失去价值从而感到空虚与without望
defense_goal: 以先发性的贬低与悲观Anticipation来降低再度失望的可能，维持心理掌控感

object_relations.self_representation: 失望且愤世的批评者、对阅读失去信心的受挫者
object_relations.object_representation: The other party (friend/fellow enthusiast) is a listener who will tire of their negative comments; the author is someone who will keep disappointing people

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When friends or the counselor invite balancing views and considering that the author may just be temporarily set back
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Understands others' balanced perspective as downplaying their own feelings, worrying that accepting an optimistic view will mean being slapped by reality again
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In a calm tone emphasizing logic and evidence, lists examples of 'quality decline', weakening emotional expression, avoiding directly experiencing disappointment.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当有人提及作者以往的优点或对其新书的积极评价时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将这些积极反馈视为自我安慰或not可靠的个案，认为not具备参考价值
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 通过挑出负面细节与反例来解释掉积极反馈，use“所以这只能说明他走下坡路”的句式维持负面结论。

manifestations: After a favorite author's new book disappoints, develops a negative and cynical view of reading as a whole
Past positive reading experiences are devalued or ignored, hard to find the value and meaning of reading
outcomes: 对阅读的兴趣与满足感显著下降

manifestations: 与同好朋友讨论时因负面评论变得尴尬与疏远
对与朋友分享自己极端反应感到犹豫
outcomes: 社交支持的利用度降低

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 频繁use“应该”句式（如“我应该早就看出来”）
将“理性读者必须预见质量”的外在标准当作自我要求

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 犹豫与朋友讨论自己的极端反应，担心被厌烦
对自身期待与判断过度苛责，反复自我检视

positive_force: Once had a deep passion for reading and positive experiences (early works brought satisfaction and creative appreciation)
愿意尝试新的观点与重构认知（在咨询中表示愿意尝试）
拥有少数同好朋友作为潜在支持资源
negative_force: 灾难化预测（预言作者“永远写not出好书”）
心理过滤与negate积极（只看负面、过去的好not算数）
“应该”句式的僵化标准导致自我苛责
人际互动中持续负面评论，增加疏离与尴尬
情绪化推理与整体化消极导致阅读意义感下降

target_behavior.behavior: 在想到该作者或阅读时出现持续的消极情绪与负面评论
antecedent: 想到其作品或阅读本身
与同好朋友讨论相关话题
target_behavior.core_reason: 灾难化预测、心理过滤与“应该”句式等not良认知维持对作者与阅读的全局性负面判断
target_behavior.function: Relieves disappointment through devaluing and avoidance, gains a subjective sense of control and tries to avoid being set back again
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased work focus、与朋友的交流变得尴尬且疏远、阅读的乐趣与放松功能显著减弱
